base_value: TreeExplainer expected value over the model's training distribution (log space).
explainer_reason: The packaged model is an XGBoost gradient-boosted tree ensemble (XGBRegressor), for which TreeExplainer is the exact, model-specific explainer.
explanation_space: SHAP values are computed in the model's actual input space — the 258 encoded features produced by the packaged preprocessing pipeline — and then aggregated to the 20 source features by summing the one-hot columns of each source feature. Summation preserves additivity exactly.

global_sample.source: train + validation partitions (the data the packaged model was fitted on)

output_space: log1p(price in ₹ lakh). Contributions are additive in log space; each contribution's price_factor = exp(contribution) is its multiplicative effect on the price.
